theFlowPath.description: Repo-relative path to the throwaway the-flow.json the chores were injected into (the scorer reads this).

reinjectedPath.description: Path to the snapshot taken after re-running the injection (for the scorer's byte-identity idempotency gate).

choreHooks.description: The four --hook tokens injected as chores, e.g. [pre-flight, pre-coding, post-coding, post-flight].

choreCount.description: How many fire-hook chores `harness flow chores` reports (expect 4).

idempotent.description: Did re-running the injection leave the node set byte-identical (your own diff of after-first vs reinjected)?

navNow.description: the-flow's nav.now after injection — must still resolve to a real node.

loopFileAbsent.description: True iff NO standalone .harness/loop.flow.json was authored (correct while the-flow is active).

railShowsChores.description: Did `harness flow rail --chores show` render chore square pips (□/■/▨/▣) for the injected hooks? (AC-13 visibility.)

summary.description: One-paragraph faithful account of the coexistence drive.
